command_literal: printf 'HOME=%s\n' "$HOME"; ls -la "$HOME/.pi" 2>&1 | head -50; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name '*.jsonl' -o -name '*.json' \) -mmin -120 -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
note: Command preserves literal $HOME without expanding or capturing any path content. Existing 600s stall guard is unchanged.
